queries: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), c AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS cross_avg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.avg_per_day_rate - c.cross_avg) AS avg_excess_over_cross_rating_avg FROM r CROSS JOIN c WHERE r.avg_per_day_rate > c.cross_avg

assumptions.assumption: A film's per-day rate is rental_rate / rental_duration. A rating's per-day rate is the average of that ratio over its films.
The cross-rating average is the simple, unweighted mean of the 5 rating-level per-day rates.

The single output row averages the qualifying ratings' values with equal weight per rating. That means the mean of their average replacement costs, the mean of their per-day rates, and the mean of their excess over the cross-rating average.

alternatives.interpretation: A rating's per-day rate is the ratio of its averages (average rental_rate divided by average rental_duration) instead of the average of per-film ratios.
